info.name: LangFlow Ai
info.description:
Runs the Langflow 'Bug Triage' flow over its REST API: one Jira issue in, a severity/priority triage out.

Set the collection variable `apiKey` to a Langflow API key (Langflow > Settings > API Keys) before sending. It is blank on purpose so no credential is stored in the repo.

The `tweaks` block in the body overrides fields on individual flow nodes for this one request, so the ticket, the reply length and the token ceiling are all controlled from Postman without editing the saved flow.

exec: // A reasoning model spends the whole completion budget inside <think> and
// gets cut off before the answer. qwen3.6-27b did exactly that here.
// Groq free tier: 1000 output tokens per minute, enforced on the ceiling
// requested rather than the tokens used. That is why max_tokens is 900.
